title: Spa Filter Maintenance Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:filter
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(filter_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many spa filter maintenance events land each day and how many distinct filter values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest spa filter maintenance records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct filter values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much spa filter maintenance activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
